caption: A sheet of bubble wrap is unrolled on a table, and small bits of dust and fluff jump onto it from the table.

sa.check: A roll of bubble wrap on a table.
The wrap is unrolled along the table.
Bits of dust and fluff jump onto the wrap from the table.
The dust and fluff are small light specks.
The unrolling comes first and the specks jump after.

pc.expect: The specks lie still until the wrap is unrolled close to them, then move to the plastic only when it is near; specks far from the wrap stay put; once on the wrap they stay.
pc.fail: Specks jump before the wrap has been unrolled toward them; or specks far across the table stream to the wrap; or specks crawl about on the wrap after landing; or specks jump off the wrap with nothing touching them.

pc.expect: Specks on the wrap cling to the plastic and stay; any that come loose fall back to the table.
pc.fail: Specks hover above the wrap without touching it; or a loose speck drifts upward; or specks rise off the table and float past the wrap; or fluff stands upright away from the plastic.

pc.expect: The wrap is a flexible plastic sheet with rows of bubbles: it unrolls, lies flat or in gentle curves and keeps its bubbles.
pc.fail: The wrap stands rigid like a board as it unrolls; or stretches like elastic; or the bubbles flatten or vanish as it unrolls; or the sheet flows like liquid.

pc.expect: Each speck moves along the line from its spot to the nearest part of the wrap and stops on it.
pc.fail: A speck flies past the wrap and off the table; or specks circle in the air above the wrap; or specks bounce off and back several times; or specks move away from the wrap.

pc.expect: One roll of wrap; the specks on the wrap are the specks from the table; nothing appears, vanishes or passes through the table.
pc.fail: Specks multiply on the wrap; or specks vanish in mid-air; or the roll duplicates; or the wrap passes through the table.

pc.expect: The wrap's colour, the table's surface and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The wrap changes colour; or the table changes pattern; or the surroundings rearrange.

note: Who unrolls the wrap is not judged.
